arxiv-1801-06801.title: Curvature-based Comparison of Two Neural Networks
arxiv-1801-06801.creator: Tao Yu, Huan Long, John E. Hopcroft
arxiv-1801-06801.description: Abstract In this paper we show the similarities and differences of two deep neural networks by comparing the manifolds composed of activation vectors in each fully connected layer of them. The main contribution of this paper includes 1) a new data generating algorithm which is crucial for determining the dimension of manifolds; 2) a systematic strategy to compare manifolds.

arxiv-1906-08885.title: Low-Resource Corpus Filtering using Multilingual Sentence Embeddings
arxiv-1906-08885.creator: Vishrav Chaudhary Yuqing Tang Francisco Guzmán Holger Schwenk Philipp Koehn
arxiv-1906-08885.description: Abstract In this paper, we describe our submission to the WMT19 low-resource parallel corpus filtering shared task. Our main approach is based on the LASER toolkit (Language-Agnostic SEntence Representations), which uses an encoder-decoder architecture trained on a parallel corpus to obtain multilingual sentence representations.

arxiv-2203-08154.title: Momentum space entanglement of interacting fermions
arxiv-2203-08154.creator: Michael O. Flynn, Long-Hin Tang, Anushya Chandran, Chris R. Laumann
arxiv-2203-08154.description: Abstract Momentum space entanglement entropy probes quantum correlations in interacting fermionic phases. It is very sensitive to interactions, obeying volume-law scaling in general, while vanishing in the Fermi gas. We show that the Rényi entropy in momentum space has a systematic expansion in terms of the phase space volume of the partition, which holds at all orders in perturbation theory.

arxiv-2209-02644.title: Modeling and Active Learning for Experiments with Quantitative-Sequence Factors
arxiv-2209-02644.creator: Qian Xiao
arxiv-2209-02644.description: Abstract Abstract: A new type of experiment that aims to determine the optimal quantities of a sequence of factors is eliciting considerable attention in medical science, bioengineering, and many other disciplines. Such studies require the simultaneous optimization of both quantities and the sequence orders of several components which are called quantitative-sequence (QS) factors.

arxiv-2404-09963.title: On the differential geometry of smooth ruled surfaces in 4 4 -space
arxiv-2404-09963.creator: Jorge Luiz Deolindo-Silva
arxiv-2404-09963.description: Abstract A smooth ruled surface in 4-space has only parabolic points or inflection points of real type. We show, by means of contact with transverse planes, that at a parabolic point, there exist two tangent directions determining two planes along which the parallel projection exhibit 𝒜 \mathcal{A} -singularities of type butterfly or worse.

pmc-10647602.title: Strategies to Make Telemedicine a Friend, Not a Foe, in the Provision of Accessible and Equitable Cancer Care
pmc-10647602.creator: Brook A. Calton, Sarah Nouri, Carine Davila, Ashwin Kotwal, Carly Zapata, Kara E. Bischoff
pmc-10647602.description: Simple SummaryIn this Perspective, we explore the benefits of telemedicine in extending cancer care to patients who face difficulties due to functional limitations, high symptom burden, and financial or geographic constraints. We also acknowledge the risk that telemedicine may worsen existing healthcare inequalities for patients who already face systemic disadvantages.

pmc-13192237.title: Exploring the somatic mutational landscape of ovarian cancer in Estonia
pmc-13192237.creator: Mikk Tooming, Kadri Rekker, Kadri Toome, Laura Roht, Piret Laidre, Olga Fjodorova, Ustina Šamarina, Sander Pajusalu, Mihkel Ilisson, Pilleriin Peets, Tõnu Jõgi, Karin Klaup, Kristiina Ojamaa, Eva-Maria Niine-Roolaht, Piret Kaarde, Elen Vettus, Jüri Piirsoo, Helen Vahar, Katrin Õunap, Tiina Kahre
pmc-13192237.description: Background and purposeThis retrospective study provides Estonia’s first nationwide overview of pathogenic and likely pathogenic variants in ovarian cancer (OC) using routine tumor molecular profiling. The aim was to characterize the mutational landscape, identify clinically actionable alterations, and evaluate the integration of germline testing.Patient/material and methodsA total of 339 OC tumor samples underwent next‑generation sequencing-based profiling.

pmc-13239947.title: CD133 Shapes Extracellular Vesicle Cargo and Angiogenic Function in Basal‐Like Triple‐Negative Breast Cancer
pmc-13239947.creator: Mireia Gomez‐Duro, Ptissam Bergam, Sara Sanchez‐Redondo, Florent Dingli, Alix Zhou, Alain Joliot, Mengliang Ye, Marta Hergueta‐Redondo, Lucas Alves Tavares, Damarys Loew, Thierry Dubois, Lorena Martin‐Jaular, Hector Peinado, Graça Raposo, Gisela D'Angelo
pmc-13239947.description: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are central mediators of tumour‐stroma communication, yet the mechanisms governing their biogenesis and functional cargo remain poorly understood. Here, we identify CD133 (Prominin‐1), selectively expressed in basal‐like triple‐negative breast cancer (BL‐TNBC) cells, acts as a key organizer of EV production and cargo composition.
